description:
Create a simulated radiation therapy target volume in InVesalius 3. The CT Cranium scan is already loaded. 

1. Create a NEW empty mask (do not modify the existing threshold mask).
2. Use the 'Manual Segmentation' tools (Brush/Pencil) to paint a circular target region (approx 20-50mm diameter) in the center of the brain on Axial Slices 60, 61, and 62.
3. Generate a 3D surface from this manually painted mask.
4. Export the surface as an STL file to '/home/ga/Documents/target_volume.stl'.

Login: username 'ga', password 'password123'.
